speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node. Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms and if the abdominal pain is localized to a specific area?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the abdominal pain radiate to your back, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as blood in your stool or persistent diarrhea? I also need to know if you have experienced any unexplained fevers or if you have been traveling recently.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: I will examine your abdomen for any masses or organomegaly, such as an enlarged spleen or liver. Please also tell me if you have experienced any recent fevers or if you have noticed any lumps elsewhere on your body.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen and Pelvis
REQUEST TEST: Lymph Node Biopsy
